scripts.build: npm run build -w @panth977/icebase && npm run build -w @panth977/icebase-server && npm run build -w @panth977/icebase-cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p packages/tests && tsc -p example-app
scripts.test:firebase: scripts/emu.sh firestore,auth,database,storage "cd packages/tests && ICEBASE_EMU=1 npx vitest run --exclude functions.emu.test.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:firebase && npm run test:functions
